summary: Long Table Growth Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K to report the consummation of its IPO of 17,250,000 units at $10.00/unit (including the full over-allotment) for gross proceeds of $172.5 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant. The filing attaches the underwriting agreement (with Santander US Capital Markets as representative), warrant agreement, letter agreement among insiders and sponsor, and investment management trust agreement. As a SPAC, the funds will be held in trust pending a future business combination. The company expects to identify a target within the allotted timeframe.
